brusque.e: The adjective is borrowed from French brusque, from Italian brusco (“abrupt, sudden, brusque; brisk; eager; sour, tart; unripe; grim-looking”); further etymology unknown.

builder.x: To cut coding time and to insure maintainability of the algorithms, an "algorithm builder tool" was constructed.
